title: Automate pricing-exemption orchestration from Security Questionnaire answers to redline acceptance thresholds
creator: Priya Nair
description:
Problem statement: Enterprise sales consistently request discretionary pricing concessions tied to answers in the customer's Security Questionnaire (SQ). Currently the Legal team reviews each request and applies bespoke indemnity/liability concessions which creates a multi-day cycle and inconsistent pricing outcomes. This ticket defines a product-managed orchestration that maps structured SQ answers to a deterministic pricing-exemption decision path and automates redline acceptance thresholds for low-risk buckets, while funneling high-risk cases to legal for manual review.

Goal: Deliver an MVP that (1) ingests SQ answers and produces a risk bucket, (2) emits a suggested pricing-exemption and contract redline payload, (3) surfaces evidence for sales and legal, and (4) auto-accepts low-risk exemption requests within clearly defined guardrails. This should reduce manual legal review for routine customers by ~60% and shorten negotiation lead time for dedicated and private deals.

Scope: 
- Integrate with existing SQ parser (confluence: /onramp/sq-parser-v2) to produce standardized answers.
- Define a risk-bucket mapping matrix (Low / Medium / High) keyed on indemnity, data residency, encryption-at-rest, shared-PII exposure, and incident notification SLAs.
- Build a pricing-exemption engine (rules + thresholds) with a transparent audit trail.
- Add UI in Contract Intake page for sales to view recommended exemption and supporting SQ evidence.
- Hook auto-accept pathway for "Low" buckets subject to preset caps (liability cap <= $250k, indemnity limited to direct damages only).
- Ensure every automated acceptance creates a ticket in Legal's queue for periodic sampling and compliance telemetry.

Out of scope for MVP: full natural-language SQ answer extraction (we rely on structured parser), machine-learning based risk scoring (future), cross-contract multi-clause negotiation flows.
acceptance_criteria: SQ parser outputs standardized fields and the orchestration service consumes them in less than 200ms per request.
Risk-bucket mapping matrix exists in Confluence and is approved by Legal and Security (link provided).
Pricing-exemption engine returns a deterministic decision with an attached rationale string for every processed SQ.
UI shows suggested exemption, rationale, and link to SQ evidence; Sales can accept/override with reason recorded.
Auto-accept path executes only for 'Low' risk buckets and enforces liability and indemnity caps configured in the engine.
All automated acceptances are logged with customer id, SQ snapshot, decision payload, and audit id; Legal sampling dashboard shows these events within 24 hours.
End-to-end tests and an integration test with Legal sampling job are green in staging before rollout.
